description: What the Visual Metrology Lab window is allowed to do. Deliberately short: this app's own commands need no permission entry, so everything listed here is either a plugin the shell genuinely needs (the native file/folder picker) or a core capability the frontend calls directly (listening for lab://progress and lab://batch, and loading cached image tiers over the asset protocol, whose reach is separately narrowed to $APPCACHE by tauri.conf.json's assetProtocol scope).
